description: This file is a shell script that sets up Git repositories and hooks, and runs tests related to the 'proc-receive' hook in a Git environment. It includes functions for repository setup, protocol testing, environment initialization, and test execution, as well as importing external test libraries.

methods.name: setup_upstream_and_workbench
methods.description: Sets up upstream and workbench Git repositories, initializes commits, tags, remote origins, and configures pre-receive and post-receive hooks.

methods.name: run_proc_receive_hook_test
methods.description: Runs tests for the 'proc-receive' hook using specified protocols (local or HTTP).

calls: source (.) commands for loading scripts and tests
